title: How many Hispanic students were enrolled in New Frontiers Public Schools Inc District in 2023-24 school year?
text:
There were 299 Hispanic students enrolled in New Frontiers Public Schools Inc District in the 2023-24 school year, 89.2% more than the previous year, according to the Texas Education Agency.
Data showed that New Frontiers Public Schools Inc District welcomed 317 students during the 2023-24 school year. Among them, Hispanic students comprised 94.3% of the student body to be the most represented ethnicity in the district.
New Frontiers Public Schools Inc District roughly covers schools within Bexar County and has a main office in San Antonio.
Among the three schools in New Frontiers Public Schools Inc District, Frank L. Madla Early College High School recorded the highest enrollment of Hispanic students in the 2023-24 school year, with a total of 168 students.
A recent study by WalletHub classified Texas as one of the least-educated states in the U.S., ranking it 41st out of 50 in educational quality and student outcomes.
Underfunding is a frequently cited challenge facing Texas’ school districts. According to a 2024 report from the Texas Education Agency, per-pupil funding has not increased since 2019, despite inflation rates rising by more than 20% since then.
“As a result, many districts in our very own Central Texas region are being forced to cut back on essential programs, services, consider school closures, and adopt deficit budgets just to provide students with the education that they deserve,” Hutto ISD Trustee James Matlock stated in an interview.
| Year | Total District Enrollment | Total of Hispanic Students | Hispanic students % |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2023-24 | 317 | 299 | 94.3% |
| 2022-23 | 171 | 158 | 92.4% |
| 2021-22 | 149 | 138 | 92.6% |
| 2020-21 | 485 | 464 | 95.7% |
| 2019-20 | 601 | 559 | 93% |
